title: Configure Referral Intake for your facility

claims.claim: Referral Intake does not have a separate setup wizard; what you can configure is which roles can see the feature.
Open Organization Role Config from the Administrator hub.
That page turns features on or off per role for an organization.

checks.pattern: "Configure which features each role can access per organization. Organization admins only.",

claims.claim: It does not set fax numbers, SLA timers, OCR thresholds, payer catalogs, or auto-assignment rules.

Roles you can assign include Administrator, Clinical Manager, Clinical Director, Clinician, Referral Coordinator, Business Development Representative, Business Development Manager, Finance/Accounts Payable, Vendor Coordinator, and Biller.

checks.note: the roles on Organization Role Config are its ROLES list
the page would need to print display labels, not role keys

claims.finding: Organization Role Config lists ten roles from its own ROLES array (frontend/src/pages/administrator/OrgRoleConfigPage.tsx:26-37): admin, clinical_manager, medical_director, clinician, referral_coordinator, bd_rep, bd_manager, finance_ap, vendor_coordinator, biller. It prints the raw key with underscores replaced (:272), so the rows read "admin", "clinical manager", "medical director", "bd rep", "finance ap" and so on. There is no Clinical Director row there; the labelled list in the sentence is USER_ROLES (frontend/src/constants/roles.ts), which this page does not use.
claims.proposed_text: The page lists ten roles, shown by their system names: admin, clinical manager, medical director, clinician, referral coordinator, bd rep, bd manager, finance ap, vendor coordinator, and biller.
claims.reason: Organization Role Config lists its own ten role keys (medical director, not clinical director) printed as system names. Replaced by ri-su-11.

claims.claim: There is no separate intake coordinator role; intake staff use referral coordinator.
Referral Intake in the sidebar opens the Patient Intake board.
Fax Review Queue in the sidebar (and the Fax Queue button on the board) opens the fax review page.
claims.finding: There is no Fax Review Queue item in the live sidebar (frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx:629-756). The Fax Queue button on the board does open it (Referrals.tsx:3313). Other routes in: the Fax Review Queue tile under Fax Center (MorePage.tsx:134; Fax Center is AppShell.tsx:751) and ⌘K "Fax review queue" (AppShell.tsx:815).
claims.proposed_text: The Fax Queue button on the board, the Fax Review Queue tile under Fax Center in the sidebar, and ⌘K "fax review queue" all open the fax review page.
claims.reason: There is no Fax Review Queue sidebar item. Replaced by ri-su-12.

claims.claim: Inbound faxes appear there once they have been received.

checks.note: a server path fills the queue from received faxes

claims.claim: If a role cannot see Referral Intake, check that role's feature access in Organization Role Config; Facility Settings → Fax, Intake SLAs, Payers → Request add, or Referral Rules are not part of this flow.
